propositions: dc_store_copy_repo fixture calls git fetch with capture_output=True and check=True, causing git's stderr diagnostic message to be discarded and only exit status 128 to be reported
git fetch origin tickets is an unretrried single network call on the critical path of a 41-minute live job, where any transient failure causes the cell to hard-error rather than retry
The failure is undiagnosable because CalledProcessError's string form does not include the captured stderr, so the root cause (auth, missing ref, refspec miss, or network error) is lost

New _run_git helper performs subprocess check explicitly and raises RuntimeError carrying command argv, exit status, and git's verbatim stderr; all three call sites (fetch, archive, ls-tree) route through it
New _fetch_tickets helper adds bounded retry (FETCH_ATTEMPTS=3 with backoff) to the fetch call only, implementing retry-then-FAIL policy so genuine misconfiguration still reds the lane
